scope: Retained native checkpoint capability records plus the explicitly separate primary Remodex adoption below; no full-method/variant completeness claim.

capabilities.limit: Pinned CLI only; sanitized startup notifications, fixed read-only/on-request policy. No account/config management.
Text only, explicit project, same origin device, one active native task. Arbitrary Desktop session takeover is deferred.
Bounded sanitized phases and assistant text. Raw commands, paths, usage and native payloads are not forwarded. Unknown interactions fail closed.
Exact command/cwd/reason and offered one-time accept/cancel only; 60s expiry. No persistent allow, file-change/permission/MCP/user-input approvals.
ACK is distinct from native terminal. Known IDs reconcile; missing mapping is never replayed. Specific observed windows only, not arbitrary power-loss guarantee.
Model/provider and account features depend on the local login; no claims for configurations not exercised.
All inventory methods/fields outside the subset, including media, realtime, plugins/config administration, PTY, steer, fork/review and other harnesses. No arbitrary RPC route.

acceptance.synthetic: Default Swift/runner tests use synthetic peers; tests do not imply actual Codex work.
acceptance.realModel: Explicitly opt-in disposable-project runner; exact executed reports and limitations are recorded in docs/project-status.md.
acceptance.device: Compilation, physical unit/native HTTP, UI gestures, cellular, microphone and notification delivery are separate evidence levels.

capabilities.limit: Signed iPhone E2EE exact-text task and separate-process same-thread recovery executed. Real results and radio limits in docs/project-status.md.
Synthetic lifecycle/approval mappings and two actual one-time command approvals. Other retained native variants have only their specific regression evidence, not blanket account/device acceptance.

Signed iPhone exact-turn cancel, same-thread continuation and separate-process recovery passed; independent 31-second no-late-marker check and native terminal evidence passed. Ownership comes from a bounded native event index because item-history RPCs are unsupported by this binary; unknown/conflicting or lost new-process ownership remains pending. Exact reports/earlier failures in docs/project-status.md.
30-second explicit recording, correction/text fallback and new-task intent have injected tests. Physical microphone, audio interruptions and Siri/Action button execution remain unverified.
Completion/failure/approval local scheduling, dedupe and routing use fake centers in tests. Actual system delivery is unverified; suspended-app push needs separately configured APNs signing/service.

Git/diff/fork/review/media and other retained source have upstream regression tests where present; no blanket physical or account acceptance. Ghostty binary and Mermaid runtime excluded. OpenCode and other harnesses are not approved product backends.
Watch remote workflow, iPad adaptation, cross-device task ownership, full UI localization, minimum OS/accessibility and distribution gates remain separately scoped.
